title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-29

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a June ’73 show highlighted by a monster Truckin’ → The Other One jam and a soaring The Other One performance.
ai_review.review: The recording, taken from the original 1973 soundboard, is generally clear with especially clean vocals and keyboards, though one listener notes a slight muddiness. Musically the second set shines – the extended Truckin' jam that morphs into The Other One, plus a powerful Morning Dew – delivering high energy despite several missing portions of the first set.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and praise both the performance (standout jams, high energy) and the soundboard quality; only one mentions mild muddiness, keeping the overall rating in the strong‑good range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear vocal and instrument mix (Bobby, Billy) with nice Fender Rhodes backing; a single comment notes the tape is "a little muddy," but overall sound is praised as great.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Missing large portions of Set 1, but the remaining material—especially the second set—flows tightly with strong transitions and extended improvisations.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Melts away the Truckin' theme into a new jam, provides melodic leads in The Other One, introspective wah‑wah work in Playin'.
band_member_comments.Bob: Patiently starts the jam, offers Wes Montgomery‑style chordal backing and strong vocals.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith delivers tasteful Fender Rhodes accompaniment during the Playin' jam; overall keyboard texture praised.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy (Bill) is noted as clear and well‑balanced in the mix.
